prompt: Minutes of the monthly training conference held on 15 September 2026 at 1000 hours in the Brigade Conference Hall, chaired by Brig SK Menon, Commander. Present: Col AP Singh (Deputy Commander), Lt Col R Iyer (CO 1 Specimen Battalion), Lt Col M Khan (CO 2 Specimen Battalion) and Maj RK Verma (Brigade Major, secretary). Item one, annual firing: the range allotment for October is confirmed; CO 1 Specimen Battalion will complete zeroing of all weapons by 30 September. Item two, training syllabus: the revised cadre syllabus is approved; the Brigade Major will circulate it to all units by 20 September.
